messages:
amanda: Quick intake from AcmePay. They asked for a per-tenant 'landing pad' capability so when their preferred models or regions are constrained we can gracefully degrade without breaking their app. They want configurable fallback order, a min-quality guard, and an easy dry-run to validate before flipping live.

amanda: Problem statement: current org-level fallbacks are too coarse for large tenants; AcmePay needs tenant-scoped rules so they can guarantee critical flows keep higher fidelity.

amanda: High-level goals:
- Tenant-scoped fallback flow (ordered list of model variants/regions)
- Per-tenant minQuality threshold to trigger alert/rollback
- Dry-run / validation endpoint + console preview
- Audit trail + UI toggle for CS/Customer to enable/disable

amanda: Non-goals: we are NOT building tenant fine-tuning or private model hosting here. This is routing/operational only.

tom: couple immediate clarifiers: how granular should fallback be? per-route, per-customer, or per-model?

amanda: start with per-tenant global landing pad; we can scope later to per-route if needed.

reena: infra constraints: proxy lookup must be fast at request-time. Recommend a small pointer on the tenant record to a shared flow object instead of embedding a full policy on every request. Also note cache invalidation when flow updates is tricky.

otto: ops asks: need a grace window (e.g., delay activation) so CS can monitor initial effects and revoke if needed. Also require opt-in consent for automatic rollback on quality drops (legal request).

sam: proposed acceptance criteria (engineering):
- proxy resolution for landingPadRef resolves in <2ms at 99th percentile
- rollout flag flips within 60s or explainable TTL
- exhausted model list -> fallback to org default and emit tenant_fallback_exhausted event

sam: product acceptance criteria:
- Customer can create landing pad via Console + API and run a dry-run that shows resolved model order + expected fallback behavior
- minQuality can be set and tied to automated rollback or manual alerting depending on opt-in
- Console shows timeline / events when landing pad triggered

reena: rollout suggestion: feature-flagged canary with staged ramp (1, 5, 25, 100). Automatic pause/halt if gating metrics breach. We can reuse existing gate infra.
tom: concrete gating numbers to wire alerts:
- quality regression > 3% absolute on eval set -> pause
- latency p95 increase > 40ms -> pause
- cost increase > 20% per 1k requests -> alert only

amanda: edge cases:
- tiny tenants (low traffic): no eval signal -> use conservative defaults and require manual enable
- simultaneous updates: use version pins on landingPadRef and explicit human override to prevent flip-flop
- cross-tenant shared-flow updates: changes must be audited and versioned

otto: telemetry payload proposal: tenant_id, landing_pad_ref, resolved_order, fallback_reason, latency_ms — keep small and append to existing rollout logs. Short retention for per-tenant events.

sam: I'll prep a simple schema for tenantLandingPad with fields: landingPadRef, minQuality, graceSeconds, rolloutFlag and an example: {landingPadRef: "shared/landingpad-v1", minQuality: "88", graceSeconds: "300", rolloutFlag: "ff/tenant-landingpad/acmepay"} (this will be stored as a small stringified config ref on tenant record).

amanda: deliverables and owners:
1) Reena/Tom: RFC draft with schema + proxy resolution + rollout recipe (due Wed EOD)
2) Sam: baseline eval for AcmePay and instrumentation queries (due Mon)
3) Otto: CS playbook & consent text + UI mock notes (due Mon)
4) Amanda: coordinate with Sales on expectations and timelines

sam: dashboard ask: add tenant filters and the landingPad tag to rollout dashboards. Need proxy events tagged. I'll prototype queries this week.

reena: acknowledged. I'll add minimal event shape and a TTL to prevent storage blowup.
amanda: thanks everyone. Please ack if you picked up an action.
tom: ack

reena: ack

otto: ack

sam: ack
amanda: I'll post RFC link here when it's live.
